body: Bus left 6 mins early today. I was at the stop by 8:41 for an 8:45 pickup and watched it pull away. Third time in two weeks. How is 'arrive 5 mins early' a solution when the bus just leaves whenever it likes?
Charged twice for the August pass renewal (₹2,750 x2). UPI refs ending 4122 and 4123. Please refund one immediately. This is rent-money stuff, not pocket change.
App crashes every single time I open live tracking. Pixel 7, latest version. Tracking is the only reason I pay for this over a BMTC bus.
AC vent above seat 12 was dripping water the whole ride. Seat soaked, my laptop bag got wet. Not okay for a service sold as premium.
Stood at the Sarjapur signal stop for 25 min while the app said 'arriving in 2'. Your ETA is fiction. #cityflo
Request: a 7:30pm return slot from Manyata Tech Park. 6:45 is too early and 8:45 too late. Daily struggle for a lot of us.
Refund for the Jul 28 cancelled ride is still pending — 8 working days now. Ticket #4471 was closed without any resolution. Escalating here.
Driver today (KA-51-6634) took the ORR flyover bump at what felt like 60. Everyone lurched forward, one lady's coffee went everywhere. Please talk to him before someone gets hurt.
Driver skipped the Silk Board stop entirely, said 'too much traffic, next stop only'. I had to take an auto back 3km. Who is paying for that?
Any plans for a direct Sarjapur Road → Manyata Tech Park route? Huge crowd does this daily in shared cabs. Happy to help with a demand poll in our office group.
Bought the monthly pass at 9am, it still shows 'inactive' at 9:40 while boarding. Driver wouldn't let me board. Paid ₹2,750 and stood on the footpath. Fix this NOW.
driver refused to wait even 40 seconds while I crossed the road waving. watched me run. drove off. cool cool. @cityflo
Bus was 40 min late yesterday and today didn't show at all. Missed two standups because of this. Cancelling my pass if this week repeats.
Not receiving the login OTP since morning. Tried 5 times, two numbers. Can't even check my bookings.
The 7:55 bus was cancelled 12 minutes before pickup (app notification), but the day fare was still deducted. Refund please, and cancellations need to come earlier than 12 minutes.
Seat 4E on my bus has had a broken recline for 2 weeks and the window leaks in rain. Small stuff, but it's EVERY day now.
Watched my ETA go 5 → 11 → 22 min in real time while standing in the sun. Then the bus arrived at minute 3?? @cityflo what is this number even measuring
Would feel a lot safer with a women-only option on the late return (post 8pm). Any plans? Asking for several colleagues too.
The ₹150 wallet credit from my referral just disappeared yesterday. No expiry mail, nothing in transactions. Where did it go?
Shoutout to today's driver on Route 14 — waited two minutes for an elderly rider and drove really smoothly. More drivers like him please 💛
The bus drove past my stop FULL. The app showed 6 seats free when I booked last night. If I book a seat, I need the seat to exist.
The weekend-service poll said 'coming soon' back in April. It's August. Any real date, or should we stop asking?
Your map pin for the Varthur Kodi stop is 400m off, on the wrong side of the junction. Two of us missed the bus last week because we were standing where YOUR app told us to stand.
Driver playing FM at full volume on the 6am bus. Respectfully, nobody wants a concert at 6am.
Pickup point was changed from my apartment gate to 700m away with zero notice. Found out when the bus wasn't there. My pass ends Sunday and I'm seriously weighing whether to renew.
Quick question: are pets allowed if they're in a carrier? Couldn't find the policy anywhere in the app.
I need GST invoices for June + July passes for company reimbursement. Support chat says 'email us' and emails go unanswered. This is my 4th attempt for a document that should be a download button.
Trying to change my pickup stop for tomorrow and the edit button is greyed out. iOS, app v4.2.1. Why is something this basic locked?
4 cancellations in 9 working days on the 8:20 Whitefield run. @cityflo I literally plan my leave balance around this bus
